title: Dan Ives: The AI Boom Is Only 15% Over—Here's What Comes Next  | Top Stocks
creator: MarketBeat
summary: Collaboration between Top Stocks (Matt Weinschenk, Stansberry) and MarketBeat (host Bridget Bennett), recorded at the Stansberry conference in Las Vegas, interviewing Dan Ives — formerly Wedbush, now Yorkville Ives and Company — on the state of the AI bull market. Ives argues the AI party started at 9:30pm, is now at about 11:30pm and runs to roughly 4am: investors are, in his view, less than 15% through the coming AI spending, with an $8–10 multiplier across tech for every $1 spent on an Nvidia chip, and 2–3 more years of tech bull market. On AI safety and possible slowdowns, he says technology always outruns regulation, self-regulation is the likely path, and slowing down hands the lead to China; safety itself is a growth area (cybersecurity, sovereign AI). He discusses Palantir and Nvidia on sovereign AI, Meta's Muse assistant and 3.5B-user install base, hyperscaler monetisation inflecting (Microsoft/Azure, Google, Amazon), neo-clouds Nebius and CoreWeave (auto-captions garble Nebius as 'Navitas' and IREN as 'Iron'), Tesla's 6–9 month robotaxi/Optimus pivot and a >80% chance of a Tesla–SpaceX merger by end-2027, Apple's new AI strategy and 2027 anniversary iPhone, AMD as a huge player under Lisa Su, and software winners/losers (Salesforce and ServiceNow must prove themselves; Adobe and Intuit face AI headwinds). The hosts note Apple and Microsoft sit in Ives's top-10 stocks to buy, but Ives states no explicit buy/hold/sell call, price or target for any ticker in the interview — all ticker entries are logged UNCERTAIN. Caption spots are garbled in places (names above; 'Turnus' for Apple's incoming CEO Ternus).
